Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 2, Verse 26

“And even if you think of it as constantly born and constantly dying, even then, mighty-armed one, you should not grieve.”

A generous move — Krishna offers a fallback argument for anyone unconvinced by the first. If Arjuna rejects the eternal self entirely, the same conclusion still holds, for entirely different reasons.
